newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna stocks add on, EVN gains ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Vienna stocks add on, EVN gains ahead of results.

text.p: Austrian stocks advanced on Monday after a lacklustre session centring on a handful of blue chips.
Traders expect share prices to show little movement ahead of the expiry of November futures and options on Friday, and see the ATX index of 21 blue chips tethered to a 1,060 to 1,080 point range.
The ATX ended today's session up 2.89 points, or 0.27 percent, at 1,073.09 with nine blue chips gaining and 12 falling.
"Support's solid at 1,060 and I expect to see 1,100 points towards the end of the year," said one trader.
Trading was subdued apart from in a few issues, notably regional utility EVN, steelmakers Boehler Uddeholm and VA Stahl.
EVN was the most active stock on turnover of nearly 42,000. It added on 23 schillings to 1,547 on investor expectations of record earnings when it releases its full-year results on Tuesday.

The day's top performer was luxury hosiery and lingerie maker Wolford, rebounding 94 schillings or 7.4 percent to 1,364 on bottom fishing after last week's weakness caused by lower-than-expected first-half sales.
The leading decliner was Boehler, shedding 2.25 percent to 782.
The all-share Vienna bourse index inched up 0.14 percent to 412.14.
The November ATX future gained 3.5 points to 1,073 on turnover of 465 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
